# Pinned Fraymus brain source

Six original kernel files from creator-owned eyeoverthink/fraymus-brain at bf7c513e97480376d2583688f9e5b43c6c44657f, retained with their original source comments. See provenance.json for canonical hashes. The worker uses the prototype classifier; Think is retained as a reference regression fixture. Unrelated executors are not exposed as workspace tools. No weights or personal state are included.
